title: docs(pm-dispatch): sweep of 7 measured SKILL corrections — os-regen list drift, the unlock sweep's three duties, verification blindness, the auto-merge signature
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6492
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6490
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6465
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6371
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6218
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6207
Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#6644

One sweep, one file (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`), seven member cards. These could not land in parallel — they all edit the same sections — and the anchor card's own body argued for exactly this shape on 2026-08-06 (「四单合并实施或严格串行」).

## Per-item checklist

Walk this against the diff; every row corresponds to a hunk, and `git diff --stat` is **1 file, +166 / -27** with nothing outside these rows.

| card | lands in | what was wrong / missing | what it now says |
|---|---|---|---|
| **#6492** | 「入队与落地 A」 + rule 2「shared contract surfaces have one owner」 | Three disagreeing readings of one list: prose said **8**, the fenced copy listed **9**, `.gitattributes` routes **10**. The copy also omitted `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/**`, and a positional reference (「最后那条是 #5107 加的」) pointed at the wrong entry once the list drifted. | The embedded copy is **deleted**. The section now carries only the retrieval command (`grep os-regen .gitattributes`) named as the sole authority, plus a paragraph recording the 8/9/10 drift as the reason a second copy is not allowed. The `.counts.md` distinction is kept but addressed **by path**, not by position. The second site (rule 2) drops its 「那八条」 and points at the same command. |
| **#6490** + **#6465** + **#6644 L4** | step 3, two new adjacent paragraphs | Three separate gaps that are **one read**: the queue view cannot see which cards block others; "the blocker closed" was being read as "the card is still true"; and a PM's "this ruling narrows the card" judgment was entering dispatch as a premise. | One passage builds the `Blocked-by:` **reverse index** and spends it three ways: (a) selection priority gains **unlock fan-out ≥ 2** between `priority:p0` and the `target:` board, with the #5702 / #6428 worked example and an explicit "ordering, not exemption" + "do not invent a `pm:blocking` label" caveat; (b) an unblocked card's **file face is re-verified at the merged ref**, with #6413/#6385's 15-minute-stale line anchors as the specimen; (c) the PM's narrowing judgment ships as a **"PM assumption, falsifiable"** block, with #6190/#6478 as the measured refutation. |
| **#6371** + **#6218** | step 5 prompt template (3 new bullets) + one narrative paragraph + step 7 review checklist | Two ways a verification run measures nothing, both absent from the file. | Prompt template: build the dependency closure **first** (`'pkg^...'`), consumption-radius scans use the **prefix** `'...pkg'`, and cross-package type changes owe a reverse-verification. The narrative names them as one family with asymmetric tells — **timing** (#6371: false-red burns time, false-green reads as a swept radius and proves nothing; #5962/#6210/#6203 in one day, #6212 as the positive sample) and **direction** (#6218: #6210's "25 packages green" via the suffix, then CI red on `@objectstack/dogfood`). Step 7 gains the reviewer's counterpart: on any "N packages green", ask which direction and whether the closure was built. |
| **#6207** | Operational notes, new note 21 | The `enable_pr_auto_merge` degradation on already-clean PRs had no reader — every new PM session re-derived it. | Note 21 carries the empty-field **signature**, the disable→enable **prescription**, the three measured cases (#6034 ~1 h silent stall, #6092, #6197), and the `blocked`-state control group (#6086/#6067/#6107) so the note is not misread as "the tool is broken". |
| **#6207** (consequence) | Operational notes section header | Adding note 21 made an **already-false** count worse: the header read 「十三条」 over 20 notes. | Header is now count-free and says why, citing #6492 as the same disease. This is the one row not requested by a card — it is the "an addition must not leave a sentence it falsified standing" rule applied to my own edit. |
| **#6644 L1** | step 5 prompt template + step 7 review checklist + step 7 ACCEPT | Both the dev template and the review checklist hardcoded `Fixes`, so a half-landing PR would silently close a card sitting in the maintainer's decision inbox — which only filters **open** issues. | The template tells the dev to switch to `Part of` when only half landed; the checklist asks whether merging **should** close the card; ACCEPT gains "verify the first line before flipping ready", with PR #6600's caught-at-review `Fixes` as the specimen. |
| **#6644 L3** | seat-sticker protocol + handover checklist step 4 | Hot-file ordering is a **standing** fact, but batch independence is recomputed per round, so it died at every handoff. | A named 「热文件串行队」 section (file → ordered cards → which region each claim covers), with `protocol.ts` carrying five cards in one term as the evidence, and the section added to the handover ledger so it survives the seat change. |
| **#6644 L5** | step 7 ACCEPT | Step 7 only verified that out-of-scope findings **exist**; at sweep volume they arrive as unrelated cards over an hour. | When a card's deliverable includes a systematic sweep, the ACCEPT comment lists its products as one block **and names the sweep criterion**, so triage grades the batch consistently (#3682's 3 findings + 1 transfer + 1 escalation as the measured volume). |

## Dropped member, with evidence

**#5925 (the anchor) is not in the `Fixes` list — its premise has expired.** Its items 1-6 were implemented and merged by **PR #6029** ("Part of #5925(第 1-6 条)", merged 2026-08-06T23:55:44Z), which is why the file grew from the 1571 lines the card cites to 2297. Verified in the current file, all six present:

- item 1 handover checklist — seat-sticker protocol, 「交接收尾清单」 seven steps
- item 2 whole-body-replace — 「座位贴协议」 (the architecture changed to one sticker per seat, so the trap is now structurally gone) plus the residual-race discipline
- item 3 three API traps — Operational notes 13 (`list_issues` OR, `labels` whole-set) and note 3 (REST core exhausts, resets on the hour)
- item 4 `priority:p0` — step 3, 「P0 插队」
- item 5 standby posture — Stop conditions, 「待命姿态」
- item 6 PM-tooling-PR exception — Guardrails and step 7 ACCEPT

Its only surviving item is **item 7** (extracting case narratives into `references/incidents.md`), which its own card marks 「⛔ 不与前 6 条同 PR」 and which the maintainer approved as a **separate pure-move PR**. So it is deliberately excluded here, and #5925 must stay **open**. Closing it via this PR would have discarded item 7 — which is, precisely, the failure mode #6644 L1 (in this same diff) exists to prevent.

## Escalated, not written in

**#6644 lesson 2 — "report at draft-PR time, do not wait for CI" — is NOT in this diff.** It is a behavioural change to the dispatch contract, not a documentation correction, and it contradicts two things currently in force: this file's own step 7 line (「os-dev 定义侧已要求『PR 开出后等 CI 收敛再交报告』,本条是它在复核侧的对账」) and the standing `os-dev` agent definition. Writing it in would leave two files instructing devs in opposite directions and would silently drop the review-side reconciliation that caught #5584's red merge. That is a maintainer ruling with a real trade-off (up to 2 h of idle dev time per the cli seat's #6024, against the CI-convergence guarantee), so it is raised in the dispatch report rather than guessed at here. This is why the card is `Part of`, not `Fixes`.

## Verification

Docs-only, `.claude/` internal agent tooling — publishes nothing, so `skip-changeset` rather than a changeset.

Gates enumerated from `.github/workflows/lint.yml` and run individually (the skill-frame family reads this exact file):

- `check:nul-bytes` — OK, 6239 tracked text files, no raw ASCII control bytes
- `check:doc-authoring` — OK, 365 files clean
- `check:role-word` — OK, 44 baselined files, no new occurrences
- `check:skill-frame-sync` — OK, 4 isomorphic copies across 3 files, 40 markdown files scanned
- `check:skill-frame-freshness` — OK, frame current with `origin/main`
- `check:skill-compatibility` — OK, 11 SKILL.md files reconciled against 77 workspace packages

Sanitizer-hostile shapes: this file documents the traps it contains, so the additions were scanned explicitly. Control-byte scan (`grep -naP` over the 0x00-0x1f / 0x7f class) is clean, fence count is balanced at 14 before and after, and the "left-angle-bracket + letter" occurrence count is **60 before and 60 after** — zero introduced. The single such sequence inside my hunks is the pre-existing `target:` placeholder (angle-bracketed "major") on a line I rewrote around — spelled without the brackets here so this body survives its own sanitizer.
